intro.title: Run a pasteurizer from your browser
intro.lead: A working simulation of an HTST milk pasteurizer, the kind of PLC and HMI system we build for dairy plants. Start it, change the recipe, cause a fault, run a CIP clean: the control logic reacts like the real machine.

bullets.title: Interlocks
bullets.text: The flow-diversion valve (FDV) sends product forward only after the holding-tube outlet has held the legal temperature. Try to override it in Manual: the PLC won't let you.

bullets.title: Alarms
bullets.text: Prioritised, time-stamped alarms with acknowledge and return-to-normal states, as ISA-18.2 recommends.

bullets.title: Trends
bullets.text: Live temperature against setpoint and divert limit, so operators see drift before it costs a batch.

intro.ctaQuestion: Want an HMI like this for your machine?
intro.try: Try it: press Start, wait for Forward, then Simulate fault.

caption: Simulated 10.1″ operator panel built to ISA-101 high-performance HMI principles: grey when all is normal, colour only for abnormal states, blue for what you can touch.

a11y.mimic: Process diagram: raw tank, balance tank, feed pump, plate heat exchanger with regeneration, heating and cooling sections, hot-water loop, holding tube, flow-diversion valve and storage tank. Live values are listed in the process panel.
a11y.trend: Temperature trend for the last 60 seconds

msg.idle: Press Start to run the pasteurizer.
msg.heating: Heating up. The FDV diverts until the holding outlet reaches {limit} °C.
msg.recovering: Product below {limit} °C is diverted back to the balance tank until the temperature recovers.
msg.forward: Product meets {limit} °C for {hold} s: FDV forward to storage.
msg.manual: Manual: you drive the FDV and the heating setpoint. The interlock still protects the product.
msg.blocked: Interlock: forward blocked. TT-102 is {t} °C, below the {limit} °C limit.
msg.fault: Steam supply pressure dropped. Watch the cold product travel down the holding tube.
msg.cipDone: CIP complete. The line is clean and ready for production.
msg.stopped: Stopped. Pumps off, steam valve closed, FDV in divert (fail-safe).

loop.title: The control loop behind every machine
loop.lead: Sensors measure, the PLC decides, the HMI keeps people in the loop and the actuators act. Then it starts again, many times a second.
loop.caption: Signal types shown are typical examples.

sensor.label: Sensor
sensor.text: Measures the process: temperature, pressure, level, flow or position.

plc.label: PLC
plc.text: Compares the value with the setpoint and runs the logic: PID, interlocks, sequences.

hmi.label: HMI / SCADA
hmi.text: Shows operators live values, alarms and trends, and passes their commands to the PLC.

actuator.label: Actuator
actuator.text: A VFD, control valve or contactor applies the PLC's output to the machine.

process.label: Process
process.text: The machine responds, and the sensor measures the new value.
